component.name: Lyncost
component.summary: Offline, privacy-first personal finance and investment tracker

description.p: Lyncost keeps your money organised without ever sending your data anywhere. Everything lives in a local database on your computer.

ul.li: Accounts, transfers and automatic net-worth tracking
Budgets with pace warnings, savings goals and recurring transactions
Loans and credit lines with drawdown and repayment history
Stocks, mutual funds and crypto with profit/loss in your base currency
Bill reminders, warranty tracking, CSV import/export and daily backups

screenshot.caption: Dashboard: monthly totals, account balances, financial health, and a 30-day projection
Investments: portfolio value, profit and loss, and allocation

description.p: Display fixes: loan cards and narrow windows.
Settings shows the real version; links point to wintershogun.com.
Safety backup before any reset, and launch hardening.
Cleaner layout: labels and badges no longer break across lines; better fit on smaller windows.
New Iris accent color and a one-line installer.
Wintershogun house style: website fonts and frost palette, larger and clearer text.
New premium look, clearer wording and several display fixes.
Rebuilt backend: reliable balances, live budgets, recurring rules, bill payments, safe restore and hashed PIN.
